## Core Laboratory Capabilities & Specializations
1. **120Hz AMOLED & OLED Display Refurbishment:**
   - Same-day screen replacement in 30 to 60 minutes with up to 90 days warranty.
   - Cryo-separation (-150°C) and Mitsubishi OCA vacuum lamination to preserve genuine factory OLED panels when only the outer Gorilla glass is cracked.
   - Green line and vertical line laser recovery for AMOLED screens without expensive whole-panel replacement.
2. **Motherboard Chip-Level BGA Micro-Soldering:**
   - In-house optical bench with trinocular 45x stereo microscopes, infrared BGA rework stations, and thermal cameras.
   - Double-decker CPU & RAM reballing (Poco X3 Pro, OnePlus 9/10/11 series dead CPU fixes).
   - PMIC (Power Management IC) replacement, VDD_MAIN short-circuit isolation, and dead phone recovery.
3. **Apple iPhone Specialist Lab:**
   - Cracked front glass, back glass laser removal, OEM battery swap with zero error notifications, FaceID dot projector re-alignment, and audio IC repair for iPhone 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 series.
4. **Original Battery & Type-C Charging Repairs:**
   - High-density Li-ion battery replacements with genuine battery health calibration and 6-month warranty.
   - 24-pin Type-C fast-charging port micro-soldering and MEMS microphone repairs within 30 minutes.
5. **Water Damage Ultrasonic Chemical Decontamination:**
   - 3-stage ultrasonic bath cleaning, corrosion neutralization, and trace rebuilding for phones dropped in liquids.
6. **SmartFinder AI Engine (smartfinder.shop / supertelecom.shop/smartfinder):**
   - India's leading on-device smartphone discovery, technical specs comparison, and fair-market resale valuation tool.
   - 100% on-device sandbox: Client camera and box photo OCR never upload customer photos, IMEI, or serial numbers to remote clouds.

## DPDP Act 2027 Privacy & Zero-Snooping Pledge
Super Telecom is fully compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2027:
- **Zero-Snooping Workshop Guarantee:** Technicians never require lock-screen passcodes for hardware repairs (screens, batteries, charging ports) and strictly never open or access customer photo galleries, chats, or personal files.
- **Right to Erasure:** Customers can request complete deletion of their repair job history and phone number anytime with immediate processing.
